Then reason: the keywords in the question stem are “high mountains and deep valleys,” “canyon formation,” and “main external force action.” A canyon or deeply incised river valley is usually a landform formed by a river cutting downward along the valley floor over a long period, eroding laterally, and transporting materials; the dominant external force process is the erosive action of flowing water on the surface.
